Sometimes it’s all I can say.  I just have to accept this moment, this situation, I can’t rush through it so I just have to exist through it. What an honor and a struggle it is to exist through it. And what else is there I can do? So I say “ok” and accept it. Accept the circumstance, or the calling, or the end, the uncertainty, hardship, frustration of it all.  Things outside my control, but that obviously affect me, so what more is there to do or say than grin and bear it?  There’s a reason I have to embrace it this way, a purpose for why I’m forced into this position. Somehow life finds a Wah to turn me into a carnival contortionist and twists my soul to fit this path I’m on.  Just trying to take it in, to take it on, to get through it.  Sending love to everyone who feels similar right now, sometimes we just need people to believe in us. I believe in you. You’ve got this.  #1924us #life #animation #mrskelly #fyp

Hey, it's OK~ ♥ #positivity#fyp#catanimation#catart   Hey there! It's okay to feel a little off sometimes. We all have days where we feel out of sorts, and that's completely normal. Don't worry about trying to please everyone around you. Instead, focus on pleasing your own body and mind. You are the only one who truly knows what you need to feel happy and fulfilled. So take the time to listen to yourself and honor your own desires. Whether that means taking a day off to rest and recharge, pursuing a new hobby that excites you, or simply saying "no" to something that doesn't align with your values, it's all about prioritizing your own well-being. Remember, you are worthy of love and respect simply for being who you are. You don't need to change or compromise yourself to please others. Embrace your unique quirks and strengths, and let them shine! So go ahead and do what makes you happy, because at the end of the day, that's all that really matters. You got this! ♥ #sendinglove music by @corook - It's OK!
